title: The High Table section cannot be a Button: Desktop refuses an Svg inside a Button
context: FR-14 puts the High Table Svg inside a plain Button keyed paqad-table, and the FR-18 fallback wraps the whole strip image in that Button. The Claude Code engine refuses both: the band render hook is skipped with 'JSX element <Button key="paqad-table"> holds strings and Text, not <Svg>' (ButtonProps: children of strings and Text only, any other element is refused; Svg presses go on an enclosing element, and only Button takes onPress). So neither the primary path nor the named fallback can ship. Everything else in S4 works (3 seats live-first, +N, section Svgs at 40/26/34 or 56/44, alts, the table action wired to openPane($, 'table')). S1-S3 are committed. Pick how the press reaches the Ledger on High Table.
